mentions.name: consensus-tools
mentions.description: An open source CLI that experiments with governance at inference time for autonomous systems. Multiple agents propose, critique, and stake on decisions before a single action is taken, rather than letting one model silently decide. It is model-agnostic, runs locally with no blockchain or financial layer, and explores whether adding explicit disagreement and cost at decision time improves outcomes in high-stakes or automated workflows.
mentions.problem: Autonomous systems let a single model silently decide actions; the project tests whether explicit disagreement and cost at decision time improve outcomes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an open source CLI that experiments with governance at inference time for autonomous systems.

The idea is to let multiple agents propose, critique, and stake on decisions before a single action is taken, rather than letting one model silently decide. It’s model-agnostic and runs locally, with no blockchain or financial layer involved.

I’m mostly exploring whether adding explicit disagreement and cost at decision time actually improves outcomes in high-stakes or automated workflows.
